description.value:
You have made a star chart as part of your studies of the heavens. It is a Tiny object that you can use as a Spellcasting Focus for your Druid spells; roll on the Star Map table or choose its form.

While holding the map, you have @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidance00]{Guidance} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{Guiding Bolt} prepared, and you can cast Guiding Bolt without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

If you lose the map, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony, during a Short or Long Rest, to magically create a replacement; it destroys the previous map.

Star Map

1d6Map Form
1A scroll bearing depictions of constellations
2A stone tablet with fine holes drilled through it
3An owlbear hide tooled with stellar symbols
4A collection of maps bound in an ebony cover
5A crystal engraved with starry patterns
6A glass disk etched with constellations

Foundry Note

Guidance and Guiding Bolt are prepared through this feature; the free castings of Guiding Bolt are its uses.
